newsitem.title: USA: USDA says Jordan gets $8 mln in PL480 to buy rice.
newsitem.headline: USDA says Jordan gets $8 mln in PL480 to buy rice.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department Tuesday said an authorization to buy $8 million worth of U.S. rice under Public Law 480, Title I was issued to Jordan.
It said the authorization provides for the purchase of about 19,000 tonnes of long, medium or short-grain milled rice or brown rice for processing.
The contracting period is Sept. 13-30 and the delivery period is Oct. 4 through Dec. 31.
Title 1, also know as the Food for Peace program, is a loan program for the purchase of U.S. farm goods with low interest rates and long-term payback periods.
